Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 21-Nov-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  FIFTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER 2025  
  Artificial Intelligence [CSE_3128]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                   Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                Compare and analyze the performance of goal-based and utility-based agents in dynamic                (5)  
  environments. Discuss how their decision-making processes differ in their applications with the help  
  A)           of examples.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           Compare and contrast between formal task and expert task in the domain of artificial intelligence.    (5)  
  Apply these themes and present suitable examples.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
2)                Analyze the states PAGE/ PEAS concept to the autonomous vacuum cleaner.                               (5)  
  
  
  A)                                                           Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           Compare among fully observable and partially observable environments in AI with example.              (5)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
3)                Analyse the pros and cons of DFS and BFS for water-jug problem solving.                               (5)  
  
  
  A)                                                           Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"
